tasks.name: 完整向量校验
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ═══ 向量状态完整校验（100%覆盖官方一致性死角 · 带具体楼层输出 · Info级别） ═══
(async () => {
  if (window.__LWB_VECTOR_VERIFYING__) return;
  window.__LWB_VECTOR_VERIFYING__ = true;

  const toast = (m, t = 'info') => {
    window.toastr?.[t]?.(m, '向量校验', { timeOut: 4000 });
  };

  try {
    const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
    const ctx = getContext();
    const chatId = ctx?.chatId;
    const chat = ctx?.chat || [];
    if (!chatId || !chat.length) return;

    const BASE = '/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary';
    const [cs, ss, dg, svi, evi, ct, cfg, emb] = await Promise.all([
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/chunk-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/state-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/vector-input-digest.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-vector-input.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/event-vector-input.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/chunk-text.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/config.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/embedder.js`),
    ]);

    const vectorCfg = cfg.getVectorConfig();
    if (!vectorCfg?.enabled) return;
    const currentFp = emb.getEngineFingerprint(vectorCfg);
    const meta = await cs.getMeta(chatId);
    const fpMismatch = Boolean(meta?.fingerprint && meta.fingerprint !== currentFp);

    const [storedChunks, chunkVecs, stateVecs, evVecs] = await Promise.all([
      cs.getAllChunks(chatId),
      cs.getAllChunkVectors(chatId),
      ss.getAllStateVectors(chatId),
      cs.getAllEventVectors(chatId),
    ]);

    const atoms = ss.getStateAtoms() || [];
    const events = ctx.chatMetadata?.extensions?.LittleWhiteBox?.storySummary?.json?.events || [];

    // ──────────────── 1. L1 检测（含切片结构破损死角） ────────────────
    const l1CorruptFloors = new Set();
    const l1CorruptChunkIds = [];

    // 【死角 A 覆盖】：官方 incomplete_cache 结构破损检查
    for (const c of storedChunks) {
      const isFloorInvalid = !Number.isInteger(c.floor) || c.floor < 0 || c.floor >= chat.length;
      const isIdxInvalid = !Number.isInteger(c.chunkIdx) || c.chunkIdx < 0;
      const isIdMismatch = c.chunkId !== cs.makeChunkId(c.floor, c.chunkIdx);
      const isTextEmpty = typeof c.text !== 'string' || !c.text;

      if (isFloorInvalid || isIdxInvalid || isIdMismatch || isTextEmpty) {
        l1CorruptFloors.add(c.floor);
        l1CorruptChunkIds.push(c.chunkId);
      }
    }

    const storedChunksByFloor = new Map();
    for (const c of storedChunks) {
      if (!storedChunksByFloor.has(c.floor)) storedChunksByFloor.set(c.floor, []);
      storedChunksByFloor.get(c.floor).push(c);
    }
    const l1DriftFloors = [];
    const l1OutFloors = [];
    for (const [floor, list] of storedChunksByFloor.entries()) {
      if (floor >= chat.length) { l1OutFloors.push(floor); continue; }
      const curChunks = ct.chunkMessage(floor, chat[floor]);
      if (curChunks.length !== list.length) { l1DriftFloors.push(floor); continue; }
      list.sort((a, b) => a.chunkIdx - b.chunkIdx);
      const isMismatch = curChunks.some((cur, idx) => {
        const stored = list[idx];
        return !stored || cur.chunkId !== stored.chunkId || cur.textHash !== stored.textHash;
      });
      if (isMismatch) l1DriftFloors.push(floor);
    }

    const chunkById = new Map(storedChunks.map(c => [c.chunkId, c]));
    const chunkVecById = new Map(chunkVecs.map(v => [v.chunkId, v]));
    const l1ChunksNoVec = storedChunks.filter(c => !chunkVecById.has(c.chunkId));
    const l1OrphanVecs = chunkVecs.filter(v => !chunkById.has(v.chunkId));
    const l1StaleVecs = [];
    const l1StaleFloors = new Set();
    for (const v of chunkVecs) {
      const c = chunkById.get(v.chunkId);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== dg.inputDigest('chunk', c.text)) {
        l1StaleVecs.push(v.chunkId);
        if (c.floor !== undefined) l1StaleFloors.add(c.floor);
      }
    }

    // ──────────────── 2. L0 检测（含楼层错位与越界死角） ────────────────
    let l0MissingFloors = 0, l0FailedFloors = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < chat.length; i++) {
      if (!chat[i] || chat[i].is_user) continue;
      const st = ss.getL0FloorStatus(i);
      if (st?.status === 'failed') l0FailedFloors++;
      else if (st?.status !== 'ok' && st?.status !== 'empty') l0MissingFloors++;
    }

    const atomById = new Map(atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId).map(a => [String(a.atomId), a]));
    const stateVecByAtom = new Map(stateVecs.map(v => [String(v.atomId), v]));
    const l0AtomsNoVec = atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId && a.semantic && !stateVecByAtom.has(String(a.atomId)));
    const l0DanglingVecs = stateVecs.filter(v => !atomById.has(String(v.atomId)));
    const l0DanglingFloors = new Set(l0DanglingVecs.map(v => v.floor).filter(f => f !== undefined));

    const l0StaleVecs = [];
    const l0StaleFloors = new Set();
    const l0RelStaleVecs = [];
    const l0FloorMismatchVecs = []; // 【死角 B 覆盖】：向量与锚点楼层不一致
    const l0FloorMismatchFloors = new Set();

    for (const v of stateVecs) {
      const a = atomById.get(String(v.atomId));
      if (!a) continue;

      // 【死角 B 覆盖】：楼层越界或与锚点对应楼层错位
      const isFloorOutOfBound = !Number.isInteger(v.floor) || v.floor < 0 || v.floor >= chat.length;
      const isFloorDiverged = v.floor !== a.floor;
      if (isFloorOutOfBound || isFloorDiverged) {
        l0FloorMismatchVecs.push({ atomId: v.atomId, vFloor: v.floor, aFloor: a.floor });
        l0FloorMismatchFloors.add(v.floor ?? a.floor);
      }

      // Hash 校验
      if (v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== dg.inputDigest('state', a.semantic)) {
        l0StaleVecs.push(v.atomId);
        l0StaleFloors.add(v.floor ?? a.floor);
      }
      if (v.rVector && v.relationHash && v.relationHash !== dg.inputDigest('relation', svi.buildRAggregateText(a))) {
        l0RelStaleVecs.push(v.atomId);
      }
    }

    // ──────────────── 3. L2 检测 ────────────────
    const evById = new Map(events.filter(e => e?.id).map(e => [e.id, e]));
    const evVecById = new Map(evVecs.map(v => [v.eventId, v]));
    const l2EventsNoVec = events.filter(e => e?.id && evi.buildEventVectorText(e) && !evVecById.has(e.id));
    const l2DanglingVecs = evVecs.filter(v => !evById.has(v.eventId));
    const l2StaleVecs = [];
    for (const v of evVecs) {
      const e = evById.get(v.eventId);
      if (!e) continue;
      if (v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== dg.inputDigest('event', evi.buildEventVectorText(e))) {
        l2StaleVecs.push(v.eventId);
      }
    }

    // ──────────────── 4. 汇总与输出 ────────────────
    const totalIssues = (fpMismatch ? 1 : 0)
      + l1DriftFloors.length + l1OutFloors.length + l1ChunksNoVec.length + l1OrphanVecs.length + l1StaleVecs.length + l1CorruptChunkIds.length
      + l0AtomsNoVec.length + l0DanglingVecs.length + l0StaleVecs.length + l0RelStaleVecs.length + l0FloorMismatchVecs.length + l0FailedFloors
      + l2EventsNoVec.length + l2DanglingVecs.length + l2StaleVecs.length;

    const lines = [
      `========== [向量校验报告] 异常项合计: ${totalIssues} ==========`,
      `[环境] 指纹状态: ${fpMismatch ? '❌ 模型变更' : '✅ 正常'} (${currentFp})`,
      `[L1] 漂移楼: ${l1DriftFloors.length} | 越界楼: ${l1OutFloors.length} | 破损切片: ${l1CorruptChunkIds.length} | 缺向量块: ${l1ChunksNoVec.length} | 孤儿向量: ${l1OrphanVecs.length} | 过期向量: ${l1StaleVecs.length}`,
      `[L0] 楼层错位: ${l0FloorMismatchVecs.length} | 缺向量: ${l0AtomsNoVec.length} | 孤儿: ${l0DanglingVecs.length} | 过期: ${l0StaleVecs.length} | 关系过期: ${l0RelStaleVecs.length} | 失败楼: ${l0FailedFloors}`,
      `[L2] 缺向量事件: ${l2EventsNoVec.length} | 孤儿事件向量: ${l2DanglingVecs.length} | 过期: ${l2StaleVecs.length}`,
    ];

    if (totalIssues > 0) {
      // 优先输出具体楼层号，方便一目了然
      if (l1DriftFloors.length) lines.push(`[明细楼层] L1 正文漂移楼: ${l1DriftFloors.join(', ')}`);
      if (l1OutFloors.length) lines.push(`[明细楼层] L1 越界楼层(>最新楼): ${l1OutFloors.join(', ')}`);
      if (l1CorruptFloors.size) lines.push(`[明细楼层] L1 结构破损切片楼层: ${[...l1CorruptFloors].join(', ')}`);
      if (l1StaleFloors.size) lines.push(`[明细楼层] L1 过期向量所在楼层: ${[...l1StaleFloors].join(', ')}`);
      if (l0FloorMismatchFloors.size) lines.push(`[明细楼层] L0 向量楼层错位/越界楼: ${[...l0FloorMismatchFloors].join(', ')}`);
      if (l0StaleFloors.size) lines.push(`[明细楼层] L0 过期向量所在楼层: ${[...l0StaleFloors].join(', ')}`);
      if (l0DanglingFloors.size) lines.push(`[明细楼层] L0 孤儿向量残留楼层: ${[...l0DanglingFloors].join(', ')}`);

      // 详细 ID 清单
      if (l1ChunksNoVec.length) lines.push(`[明细ID] L1 缺向量 chunkId: ${l1ChunksNoVec.slice(0, 10).map(c => c.chunkId).join(', ')}${l1ChunksNoVec.length > 10 ? '...' : ''}`);
      if (l0AtomsNoVec.length) lines.push(`[明细ID] L0 缺向量 atomId: ${l0AtomsNoVec.slice(0, 10).map(a => a.atomId).join(', ')}`);
      if (l2EventsNoVec.length) lines.push(`[明细ID] L2 缺向量 eventId: ${l2EventsNoVec.map(e => e.id).join(', ')}`);
      if (l2DanglingVecs.length) lines.push(`[明细ID] L2 孤儿向量 eventId: ${l2DanglingVecs.map(v => v.eventId).join(', ')}`);
    } else {
      lines.push('✅ 全部层级向量数据、结构与哈希完全一致（不会触发界面红字）');
    }
    lines.push('====================================================');

    for (const line of lines) {
      console.info(line);
    }
    toast(`[Info] 向量校验完成，异常: ${totalIssues}`, 'info');

  } catch (err) {
    console.info(`[Info] 向量状态校验异常: ${err?.message || err}`);
  } finally {
    window.__LWB_VECTOR_VERIFYING__ = false;
  }
})();
<</taskjs>>
